items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: Who I liked very much at the time.

ctx.x: I guess I never (inaudible). There was another trumpet player back in those days too. Smith. And there was one before Louis named Johnnie Duff.

Uh-huh. Who I liked very much at the time. He used to do the double up time thing -- did you know that (inaudible). He used to do it with three majors and then double up the fourth one (singing). And it would like every fourth chord he would do double time you know.
